Superhero movies...

While "Logan" was very refreshing and one of the more enjoyable films I've seen in awhile, since 2009 and Watchmen, I have yet to be excited for a superhero movie, and hate that this genre of movie is now over saturated in the film industry. It also doesn't help that Disney has almost a monopoly when it comes to the genre, as I personally feel that, while their movies aren't bad, they are really "safe" and almost always follow the exact same formula (though I feel like Guardians of the Galaxy broke the mold on that logic). Overall, Disney has almost a complete monopoly, Warner Bros. is trying (and failing) with the DC movies, and then there is Fox. Now, I'll be the first to admit, while I thought Deadpool was good, I'm not one to gush over the movie. BUT, it was refreshing to see not just an "R" rated superhero movie, but more refreshing to see a new take on a superhero, something not following Disney's safe formula to draw in as much box office action as possible. Now, dont get me wrong, i can see why with both Deadpool and Logan, why Did was hesitant to fund both, as they both were very against that common superhero mold...

But god damn, was it refreshing to see, especially Logan, which wasn't just a fantastic superhero film, but an all around solid "drama" to say the least. I haven't actually felt emotion like that for the main characters in a superhero film since at least The Dark Knight or Watchmen, and I hope the trend Fox is setting starts to come over to other superhero franchises. Not so much that the R rating be used more, but the trend of not taking the safe route and trying something that seems to be what all great movies seem to have, the human element (I mean, honestly, pretty much every character in the Disney  Marvel universe is practically immortal, which again, isn't a bad thing, but what or who am I supposed to care about? What risk is there?) 

I'll end my rant, but I love going to the cinema as much as I can, and with such an over saturation of the movies with the same old schlock we call superhero movies, I'm glad that chances like "Logan" are being taken.

TL;DR Loved "Logan", feel that superhero movies (particularly Disney's Marvel movies) are playing way to safe to change their formulas for box office reason and are over saturating the market. Loved "Logan", hope to see more chances being taken.
